description: Create one DID-owned Atlas incident watch with a server-to-server X-Agent-Key header and explicit confirmation. Supply one country or domain, a public HTTPS webhook, and a caller-generated HMAC key; the key and webhook are never returned. A bare scope without the header remains a read-only setup check. A stored watch does not prove alert delivery.

confirm.description: Required true to create a persisted watch

domain.description: DNS domain to assess for watch support

hmac_key_hex.description: Caller-generated 32-byte webhook verification key; retained by caller

webhook_url.description: Public HTTPS webhook destination for signed incident-created events

name: watch
